shared_elements: ships or boat-like elongated forms with vertical strokes
clustered abstract signs across an open rock/stone surface
large dominant figure among smaller signs
justification: Both surfaces present schematic, silhouette-like human figures and small quadrupeds scattered among elongated hull-like forms bearing rows of short vertical strokes (crew-marks), with a large prominent figure dominating smaller signs distributed over an irregular open surface rather than in framed panels. The clearest difference is that A is organised around one huge striding, arm-raised figure with only a few sparse accompanying signs, whereas B is a dense, crowded field of many comparably sized ships, animals and figures filling the whole surface, and the rendering conventions differ (broad flat painted/pecked silhouettes versus finely outlined relief detail).
